Lemon Tree Hotel, Amritsar is located in Model Town, GT Road, on Grand Trunk Road, one of Asia’s longest and most important roadways. The hotel is just a few minutes away from the railway station and Gobind Ghar Fort, and is in close proximity to Sadda Pind and the famed Golden Temple. It is strategically situated close to not just the most famous monuments in the city, but also to the neighboring commercial and financial districts.
Within a 4 km radius around the hotel, guests can access some of the most renowned locations of the city, including the ethereal Golden Temple, also known as Harmandir Sahib. It is the most important pilgrimage site for Sikhism and the house of the Akal Takht, the highest seat of earthly authority of the Khalsa. The Gurudwara is known not just as a place of religious worship, but as a beacon of serenity and peace.
The historic Jallianwala Bagh, next to the Golden Temple Plaza, houses a memorial of national importance to commemorate the death of peaceful celebrators and stands as a reminder of the Indian fight for freedom. Guests can also easily access Durgiana Temple, the Maharaja Ranjit Singh Museum and the beautiful Amritsar Cantonment Area.
Lemon Tree Hotel, Amritsar welcomes you with cheery greetings, friendly smiles and a whiff of the signature lemon fragrance. The hotel offers a mix of 64 rooms and suites, a conference room, a 24x7 multi-cuisine coffee shop - Citrus Café, a rooftop bar – Slounge, as well as a fully equipped fitness center, refreshing swimming pool and wellness spa. The hotel is also supported by a 5,500 sq. ft., state-of-the-art conferencing and meeting space, Tangerine Grand, ideal for corporate gatherings and social events, as well as 550 sq. ft. conference room, Tangerine, which can also be used as a private dining room for elegant intimate gatherings.

Besides the Jim Corbett National Park, nestled snugly amidst 8 acres of greenery and tranquillity and on the banks of the serene, soothing monsoon river Dhela is The Golden Tusk Resort in Ramnagar. Situated in the peacefulcountryside in the neighbourhoodof Ramnagar, the resort resides on the edge of the forest reserve and is just a 5-minute drive away from the Jhirna and Dhela Safari zones. The resort is also well connected to some of the great tourist attractions such as the Garjiya Devi temple and The Jim Corbett Museum.

Situated on the banks of Yamuna River in the city with a variety of historic essence, Agra, Aram Bagh, or Ram Bagh, as it is currently known is a famous tourist location, consisting of gardens built by the Mughal rulers during their tenure of rule in India. The gardens are beautifully constructed, depicting the love for nature that the Mughals had. It was constructed by Babur, the first ruler, who also laid the foundation stone of the Mughal dynasty. Later, Jahangir, son of Akbar, looked after the maintenance of the gardens, followed by Noor Jehan, who made a lot of changes and additions to the structure under her governance. Having Yamuna River as the central element, the garden is mainly themed on water, having four sections which have water drawn from the river itself. In the surrounding areas, the gardens have the residual ruins of some ancient houses which were built with red sand stones.

Guests can head to the outdoor pool for a swimming session, gymnasium for their daily workout or spa for rejuvenating massages. Lemon Tree Premier Delhi Airport has business centre and meeting space for corporate and social gatherings. 24-hour reception, tour desk, currency exchange, free Wi-Fi and parking are also offered. At Citrus Café, guests can indulge in lip-smacking Indian and International dishes. Authentic Pan-Asian cuisine is served at Republic of Noodles. Slounge is the place for appetisers and beverages while enjoying pool, playstation and music. Delhi City Centre and Gurgaon City Centre are accessible in a thirty minute drive. Top amenities
